name: harden-remaining-process-drift-gates
title: Harden remaining process drift gates
description: Problem: several process-safety guarantees still have residual soft or drifting surfaces. Evidence: runtime-reviewer-contract hardcodes an obsolete story worktree CLI path; agent prompt templates still allow reviewRound:number snippets to survive; audit:silent-catches reports uncategorized catches without failing on regression. Desired outcome: these checks are hardcoded and mechanically fail on drift. Scope: update contract scripts and prompt schema checks only, preserving existing local dirty changes and clarifying non-fully-mechanical guarantees through explicit evidence boundaries.
